Frontend._comment: Where the links in emails point. The site's first launch profile, and the one its README leads with, is http on 5090; 7178 is served only by the https profile. Pointed at 7178 this sent every verification and password-reset link a developer generated to a port nothing was listening on, so the one flow you cannot check by clicking around the site was also the one you could not test at all.

DevTools._comment: A developer's own machine, holding a sample dataset and nothing else. POST api/dev/reset-database as an Admin drops the schema, recreates it and rebuilds the demonstration data, which is how a test run starts from a known state instead of from whatever the last one left. Set only here: appsettings.json keeps it false, so no other deployment inherits it. The endpoint refuses anyway wherever Seed:DemoData is off, since data worth keeping is the thing that switch marks.
